name: Hypr Screen
author: kpanuragh
description: Turn your Android phone into a Hyprland monitor, and run it from the bar: connection, paired phones, clipboard, sound and mic in one click.

barWidget.description: Your phone as a second screen, one click away: see or end the connection, send windows and app sound to the phone, forget paired phones, and switch clipboard, sound and mic (synced with the phone app).

schema.label: Hide when idle
schema.description: Show the icon only while a phone is connected.
